in_hebrew.name: Calista
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Beautiful, gentle, and quiet
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Calista הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Calista is derived from the Greek word 'kalos' meaning beautiful, and 'istos' meaning one. In Greek mythology, Calisto was a nymph who was loved by Zeus and transformed into a bear. After her transformation, Zeus visited her in bear form and she gave birth to a son named Arcas. Calista is a name full of grace, beauty, and strength.
